description_en: Retrieves the enterprise name, enterprise agent ID, and super administrator information for a specified enterprise
description_zh: 通过调用本接口，可获取指定企业的企业名称、企业代理ID以及超级管理员信息
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen query-corp-detail-info --target-corp-id btripxxxxxx --target-third-corp-id alibabaxxxxxxx --account-id 221000000000668 --x-acs-btrip-corp-token aqfr000021 --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryCorpDetailInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the business travel enterprise to query.
You can only query information about enterprises that your application is authorized to access
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的商旅企业ID。
只能查询可调用企业的企业信息
parameters.name: target_corp_id

parameters.help_en:
The third-party enterprise ID to query.
You can only query information about enterprises that your application is authorized to access.

When querying by third-party enterprise ID, the Taobao account ID is required
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的第三方企业ID。
只能查询可调用企业的企业信息。

使用第三方企业ID查询时，必须填写淘宝账号ID
parameters.name: target_third_corp_id

parameters.help_en:
The Taobao account ID.

Used in combination with the third-party enterprise ID to query enterprise information
parameters.help_zh:
淘宝账号ID。

结合第三方企业ID查询企业信息
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.

When calling this operation over HTTP, include this as a required parameter in the request URL. For information about how to obtain it, refer to: Enterprise access token (https://open.alibtrip.com/#/document/server/corptoken-enterprise-access-credential?handbookId=development-support).

When appending to the URL, use `corp_token=value` instead
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。

通过 HTTP 方式调用本接口时，需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://open.alibtrip.com/#/document/server/corptoken-enterprise-access-credential?handbookId=development-support)。

在拼接时，推荐使用 `corp_token=value` 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

module.description_en: The details of the response. Fields with null values are not returned
module.description_zh:
返回结果详情。
若字段值为null，则不返回该字段信息

open_agent_id.description_en: The business travel enterprise agent ID

super_admin_name.description_en: The name of the business travel enterprise super administrator
super_admin_name.description_zh: 商旅企业超级管理员姓名

super_admin_phone.description_en: The phone number of the business travel enterprise super administrator
super_admin_phone.description_zh: 商旅企业超级管理员手机号

user_id.description_en: The user ID of the business travel super administrator
user_id.description_zh: 商旅超级管理员用户 ID

requestId.description_en: The unique ID of this request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

traceId.description_en: The global trace identifier for the request, typically used for troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题排查定位
